_readme: Biological-realism ranges for Netmorph parameter optimization. HARD limits = the team's authoritative parameter ranges (days 20-25; pyramidal 16-128; interneuron 16-128; minneuronseparation 10-15 um; shape.radius 100-200; shape.thickness 20-50; dm.weight 0.1-1.0); parameters must NEVER leave them. Fixed config: growth_F=0.39, growth_nu0=0.00013889. Density (10k-50k/mm^3) and pyramidal fraction (70-80%) are WARNINGS only (still reported). Every entry has a 'source'.

pyramidal.note: Team hard limit (docs, as relayed 2026-11-09). | morph_tests2 COPY: max 128 -> 300 (Randal allowed >128 pyramidal, relayed by John 2026-11-25; morph_tests2 only).

D_synmax.pyramidal.pyramidal.note: Maximum only, min 0 (team: Randal Koene, email 2026-11-13, confirmed hard limits proposed by John). Spiny pairs bridge up to ~1.5 um; aspiny interneuron pairs 0.1-0.15 um.

D_synmax.pyramidal.interneuron.note: Maximum only, min 0 (team: Randal Koene, email 2026-11-13, confirmed hard limits proposed by John). Spiny pairs bridge up to ~1.5 um; aspiny interneuron pairs 0.1-0.15 um.

D_synmax.interneuron.pyramidal.note: Maximum only, min 0 (team: Randal Koene, email 2026-11-13, confirmed hard limits proposed by John). Spiny pairs bridge up to ~1.5 um; aspiny interneuron pairs 0.1-0.15 um.

D_synmax.interneuron.interneuron.note: Maximum only, min 0 (team: Randal Koene, email 2026-11-13, confirmed hard limits proposed by John). Spiny pairs bridge up to ~1.5 um; aspiny interneuron pairs 0.1-0.15 um.

netmorph_growth_parameters._note: Fixed by the team; not optimized.

neuron_density_per_mm3.note: WARNING only (not rejected). Density range from docs. Radius/thickness unit (um) is an ASSUMPTION.

pyramidal_fraction.note: WARNING only (not rejected). Docs: pyramidal 70-80 %, interneurons 20-30 %. Phase0 samples the two counts independently (fraction 11-89 %), so many Phase0 rows violate this.

assumed_interneuron_fraction_if_column_m.note: Phase1 labeled files have no interneuron column; interneuron count is then imputed as pyramidal*0.25/0.75 (midpoint of docs 20-30 %) for density checks only.

min_separation_vs_soma.formula: minneuronseparation >= 2*mean_soma_radius_of_mix where pyr radius=8.5, int radius=5 (midpoints of docs ranges)
min_separation_vs_soma.note: ASSUMPTION: that minneuronseparation is a centre-to-centre distance in um. Netmorph semantics not verified, so this is only a soft flag.

synapses_per_neuron.note: Docs numbers. Reported as predicted usable_connections / n_source_neurons, but this is NOT a like-for-like comparison: the simulated patch holds only ~100 neurons and 'usable connections' is a filtered subset, so per-neuron counts are expected to be orders of magnitude below 5k-10k. Info only, never rejects. No docs number for Int->Pyr (left null).
